Instructions: Choose a shade that matches your natural beard or mustache color. Protect clothing and surfaces. Wearing gloves provided, squeeze the same amount of color and developer into the tray. Mixture must be a 1:1. ratio. Be sure to replace caps of both containers immediately to preserve your color and avoid exposure to air. Mix product thoroughly in the plastic tray with the Brush. For maximum effectiveness, use the brush in the kit to apply the color mixture right away to dry facial hair. Start application where hair is the greyest, distribute up and down gently to cover all the hair evenly. Keep gloves on while massaging product on beard and mustache. Start counting time after application is completed. Process 10 minutes or less to prevent the color from going too dark. Rinse product off facial hair with warm water until water runs clear. Then shampoo facial hair thoroughly with shampoo or beard wash. Do not use bar soap. Clean brush for future use. Instructions of preliminary test: The preparation may cause serious inflammation of the skin in some persons, and a preliminary test should always be carried out to determine whether a special sensitivity exists or not to make the test, a small area of skin behind the ear or on the inner surface of the forearm should be cleansed. Using either soap and water or alcohol, and a small quantity of the hair dye, as prepared for use should be applied to the area and allowed to dry. Alter 48 hours. the area should be washed gently with soap and water. If no irritation or inflammation is apparent, it is usually assumed that no hypersensitivity to the dye exists. The test should however, be carried out before each application. On no account should the hair dye be used for dyeing eyebrows or eyelashes as severe inflammation of the eye or even blindness may result.

It includes bondbar Bonding Pre-Shampoo, bondbar Bonding Shampoo, bondbar Bonding Conditioner and bondbar Bonding Styling Cream.
